name: gravity-grid
title: Gravity grid
description: A grid of dots or lines that bends towards the pointer like a gravity well, on a canvas.

props.name: variant
props.description: Dots at each crossing, or the grid lines themselves.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between grid points in CSS pixels.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far from the pointer the pull reaches, in CSS pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: How hard points are pulled; 1 is a gentle well.

props.name: gridClassName
props.description: Classes for the grid layer; its text colour colours the grid, e.g. `text-primary/50`.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown on top of the grid.
